brief: Smooth, fast-talking, shameless street-market bootleg DVD hustler with a sly grin in the voice, whispers deals, oversells everything as totally legit and one hundred percent original

lines.v_seedance_line: Any movie you want. Any actor you want. Any lawyer you want.
lines.v_seedance_intro: Two lines of prompt. Zero licenses. Action!
lines.v_seedance_winq: Your defeat is now available in 4K. Please do not tell Disney.
lines.v_seedance_taunt0: Say cheese. You are now in my movie. You did not sign anything.
lines.v_seedance_taunt1: I generated this punch from a very famous movie. Which one? No comment.
lines.v_seedance_taunt2: Tom versus Brad, round two. Starring you, as the stunt double.
lines.v_seedance_low0: Adding safeguards! Adding safeguards! Please do not sue me!
lines.v_seedance_winq1: Premiere tonight. Red carpet. Very small print.
lines.v_seedance_winq2: Box office: one billion views. Royalties: zero.
